item: Row 288 batch 5: 95 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 139 bare create_engine calls in 95 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files and every test file importing one of them pass (1934; test_rollup_scan_plan.py stays bare because its seeds break foreign keys, and goes with the foreign-key files). The ratchet ceiling goes from 356 to 217 calls in 162 files. Test-only, no release line.
